reference_rationale: Advance compiled-conditioning as a development-qualified secondary reference for the18-variant experiment. Both32-scene evaluations meet the shared explicit diagnostic limits and all fixed blinded candidate votes are yes. The metric-selected supplement shows no obvious added semantic defect in the inspected views. The extra conditioning cache has very small direct saved-output differences versus compiled-default (11/32 exact), so it is not called bitwise equivalent. This selects the next study design only; separate all32 exact conditioning, current numerical semantic proofs, main quality policies, held-out tests and200-request timing remain mandatory.
remaining_requirements: Main development aggregate and separately frozen reference-specific policies
All-32 exact conditioning anchor; current scoped numerical proofs for any headline timing
Held-out metrics and accepted blinded reviews; workload-specific variability and timing evidence
Branch-specific live budget reconciliation; no allocation or funding created by assembly
scope: Accepted to advance the development study design only. Main development aggregation, exact semantic proof, held-out quality and timing are incomplete.

policy_rationales.freeze_fraction_increase: Chosen development maximum increase in the existing global frozen-transition fraction relative to generated upstream is zero. This prevents added global freezing under that metric; it does not rule out localized object freezing or prove the upstream output matches recorded motion.
policy_rationales.lpips: Chosen development maximum per-clip LPIPS is 0.003 under the pinned AlexNet LPIPS evaluator. This is a study-specific development criterion, not a universal perceptual threshold. Apply it only with sealed fixed-subset and metric-selected worst-case visual/temporal review, and report the observed distribution.
policy_rationales.rmse: Chosen development maximum per-clip RMS perturbation is 1% of the normalized pixel range, equivalent to 2.55 levels on an 8-bit scale. This is an aggregate energy budget, not a claim that every pixel error is invisible. Sparse maximum pixel differences remain reported and reviewed.
policy_rationales.temporal_derivative_mae: Chosen development maximum mean perturbation to frame-to-frame differences is one 8-bit level (1/255) per clip. It is a temporal consistency proxy, not optical flow, trajectory adherence or a safety measure. Ordered-frame review remains required.

compiled-conditioning.rationale: Accept for development study reference selection only: all32 matched real clips meet the explicitly chosen RMSE, LPIPS, temporal and global-freezing criteria; all4 fixed blinded cases are accepted relatively by an agent reviewer across24 ordered frames. Root additionally inspected the two metric-selected worst-case default comparisons using all ordered atlas frames and the maximum-error native frame in each. The compiled-conditioning comparison shares the32 inputs and is directly very close to compiled-default. Maximum pixel differences and historical strict numerical failures remain visible. No claim of universal perceptual indistinguishability, bitwise equivalence, driving validity, held-out acceptance or headline speedup.
